category_title: Quiet fourth-grade student with learning disabilities who prefers working alone and struggles with task initiation
scenario_title: Revising a draft to add details and cohesion
minimal_context: Tyrone is sitting in the general classroom working on revising his draft to add creativity and interesting language.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Tyrone, it is time to revise your draft. Please add some creativity, interesting language, and feeling to your writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly without being able to start writing. He looks around, finding it difficult to concentrate in the noisy atmosphere of the classroom.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should write? Just put some of your ideas down on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (He has trouble generating and articulating ideas. He slowly writes on his paper: "I would read a book . play vido games with my brother .")

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, keep trying. Write some more to make it a cohesive story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (He struggles with language fluency and gives up writing easily, just listing more disconnected events without clear focus: "I would play football with my friends . Then I will watch a movie with my mom and brother .")
